defect: a stream flush signal is combinationally inserted into the asynchronous reset
rationale: flush is not synchronized or filtered and can asynchronously clear valid_o through a combinational reset net.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the active-high reset pipeline context to one stream-valid register.

mutation.description: Combined the asynchronous reset with an unsynchronized flush input before the register sensitivity list.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Async reset is rst|flush, a combinational function of a functional input, so glitches can reset the flop.
